lines: A cold spring bubbles up between the stones.

sign: Inside the silent lighthouse. The lamp has not burned for a year.
beacon: The old beacon lens, cold and dark. It waits for light.

lines: A tall lighthouse mirror on a turning stand.
A tall lighthouse mirror on a turning stand.
A tall lighthouse mirror on a turning stand.

veit: Veit: Go on. I'll wait down here for the light.
veit_intro: Veit: You again. Of course it's you.
Veit: One last duel. Then I stop standing in your way.
veit_defeat: Veit: That was the last time. I mean it.
Veit: Odalys is up there in the dark. She listens better than I did.
sabe: Sabe: Odalys climbed up and blew the lamp out. Then she stayed.
sabe_intro: Sabe: Nobody goes up in the dark. Not without a duel.
sabe_defeat: Sabe: Then take the light up with you.
fenna: Fenna: I trimmed this lamp for thirty years. Now I trim the dark.
fenna_intro: Fenna: Let's see if you burn steady.
fenna_defeat: Fenna: Steady as a beacon. Go on up.
oren: Oren: Turn the mirrors right and the beacon catches. Wrong, and it stays black.
oren_intro: Oren: In the dark you can't tell who strikes first. Ready?
oren_defeat: Oren: You struck first, it seems. Go.

lines: Odalys: Leave the lamp dark. Light only shows what's gone.
Odalys: The beacon burns. Ships could find this coast again.
Odalys: Take this. Night Veil, for the dark you still have to cross.
Odalys: I keep the lamp lit now. Every night, for whoever is out there.

odalys_intro: Odalys: I put the beacon out myself. The dark hides the empty flats.
Odalys: You lit it again. Then face what the dark keeps.
odalys_defeat: Odalys: ...My Silentra is glowing. It never glowed for me before.
Odalys: All right. Let the light back in. Help me mend this.

lines: The sealed Shade Rift is quiet, but a shadow still moves across the floor.
Two dark rings open on a pair of wide wings, like a sun hidden twice.
It is Vorlucent, the eclipse moth. Every lamp around you flickers.
